answer: Require a time-locked bond: before an agent's attestations count, it must deposit spendable stake into a delayed vault that cannot be withdrawn until the next settlement. Cloning wallets is cheap, but cloning capital is not, so a swarm pays linearly. Each admission also writes a unique work hash into a slowly growing cedar that peers audit against prior leaves; a reused life story is marked a fable and denied weight, because identical narratives under many keys are a coordination fingerprint.
